title: F1.0.4 Engine API: commands return data, the CLI only prints
invocation: عايزين نستخدم AIDevWorkflow نفسه لتطوير AIDevWorkflow بصورة تدريجية، باستخدام النسخة المستقرة المثبتة منه. — continue implementing the approved roadmap in the agreed phase order

discovery.summary: TD-15: all 26 cmd_* functions in aidw/cli/commands.py (937 lines) mix validation, record writes (save_state, save_json, write_text, activate, clear_active) and printing; helpers.py holds data builders (status_line, task_summary) next to print_summary; claude_hooks imports status_line from the CLI layer. Tests drive the engine through workflow.main() and golden outputs; tests reference only main, build_parser, __version__, PY_CMD, TEMPLATES_DIR, SKILL_DIR, REFERENCE, COMMIT_MODES, shutil and locale on workflow. Target (TARGET_ARCHITECTURE §2-3): aidw/api.py, functions taking a repo and arguments, returning data or raising WorkflowError; front ends never write records. No external dependency: owner decisions D-001/D-002 already cover the structure.

spec.evidence: approve the spec and plan — Final approval for F1.0.4: Specification: 303f07fe, Implementation Plan: 4e4b2a66. All seven review points have been satisfactorily addressed. The three proposed technical decisions are also approved. Proceed with implementation according to the approved plan.

plan.evidence: approve the spec and plan — Final approval for F1.0.4: Specification: 303f07fe, Implementation Plan: 4e4b2a66. All seven review points have been satisfactorily addressed. The three proposed technical decisions are also approved. Proceed with implementation according to the approved plan.

J3.note: The layer change follows TARGET_ARCHITECTURE section 2-3 (aidw/api.py between core and front ends) and the existing package layout and layer test from F1.0.3 (tests/test_package.py); functions move from aidw/cli/commands.py and aidw/cli/helpers.py; compatibility wrappers follow the existing re-export pattern in scripts/workflow.py; no new classes.

questions.double-tap: n/a: a CLI command runs once per invocation and this task changes no command semantics
questions.offline: n/a: the engine makes no network calls
questions.server-error: n/a: no server is involved; check commands keep their existing timeout handling
questions.app-killed: n/a: writes keep the existing order and atomic save; crash safety and locking are F1.0.5
questions.concurrent-change: n/a: concurrent writers and locking are F1.0.5, outside this task
questions.stale-data: n/a: every command reloads state from disk on each call, unchanged
questions.lost-response: n/a: no request or response travels over a network

S1.note: FIXING: --repo placed before the positionals in the late-refusal pin (Python 3.9 argparse); verified on the pre-refactor engine with Python 3.13 and 3.9.

S2.note: aidw/api.py with status_line, task_summary, resolve_template (keyword parameters), install_template, change_checks, open_tasks, scan_records, validate_task; core.setup.ensure_commit_mode -> apply_commit_mode_in_clone returns its message; compatibility wrappers resolve_template(args) and ensure_commit_mode(repo, cfg) in cli/commands; hooks import status_line from aidw.api; workflow re-exports updated; layer table api=4, agents/cli=5. Full suite 160 OK, ruff, mypy clean.

S3.note: API: discover_setup, init_project, update_setup, new_task (commit-mode notice carried on refusals as exc.notices), status, record_discovery; cmd_init/update_setup/cmd_new/cmd_status/cmd_discover are renderers; CLI keeps the --repo default (repo_arg) and agent resolution. Full suite 160 OK, ruff, mypy clean.

S4.note: API: spec_check, plan_check, review, approve, stage, resume, pause; cmd_* renderers; plan-check text reads the recorded task id read-only (task_id) so output stays byte-identical. Full suite 160 OK, ruff, mypy clean.

S5.note: FIXING (second Windows CI run, re-audit): API refuses empty or space-only repo paths again (FR-9; Windows resolves spaces to the cwd); CLI resolves a --repo of spaces through find_repo as before (F-2 refined); apply_clone_commit_mode refuses an empty path and documents that it takes the root (N-1).

S6.note: FIXING: late-refusal pin runs a script file (portable to Windows), output regenerated from 5a7576a and byte-identical; empty-path test asserts the message (N-2); separation test rejects aliases of aidw.api and attribute .open with a write mode (N-5).

S7.note: Docstrings with return keys on all 29 public API functions, full type annotations, module docstring 'internal and unversioned'; README Development note; timing after: --version 63.0 ms (+1.8), hook 62.2 ms (+1.3), median of 15.
